scripts.db:up: aws rds start-db-instance --db-instance-identifier gadget-introduction-web-dev --region ap-northeast-1 --query DBInstance.DBInstanceStatus --output text && aws rds wait db-instance-available --db-instance-identifier gadget-introduction-web-dev --region ap-northeast-1 && echo DB is available, ready for npm run dev
scripts.db:down: aws rds stop-db-instance --db-instance-identifier gadget-introduction-web-dev --region ap-northeast-1 --query DBInstance.DBInstanceStatus --output text
